serverInfo.name: forgepoint-signal
serverInfo.title: ForgePoint Signal
serverInfo.description: Daily regulatory monitoring for US estate, trust, and tax law changes. MCP-native with x402 micropayment support. Updated daily from the Federal Register and IRS Newsroom.

tools.name: preview_regulations
tools.description: Get a free preview of the 5 most recent US regulatory changes monitored by ForgePoint Signal. Covers estate, trust, gift, and inheritance tax law. Updated daily from the Federal Register and IRS Newsroom.

tools.name: search_regulations
tools.description: Search the full ForgePoint Signal regulatory database by keyword, jurisdiction (federal/state), category (estates/trusts/tax/gift), or impact level (low/medium/high). Returns full entries with plain-English summaries and source links. Updated daily from the Federal Register and IRS Newsroom.

tools.name: get_regulation_detail
tools.description: Get complete detail for a specific regulation entry including full summary, affected law or code section, effective date, and source document link. Data is sourced from the Federal Register and IRS Newsroom.

tools.name: get_recent_by_impact
tools.description: Get the most recent high-impact regulatory changes sorted by impact level. Ideal for daily briefings or monitoring material changes requiring immediate attention. Updated daily from the Federal Register and IRS Newsroom.
